entries.text: Manager work loop: restart_service is DEFERRED until after the manager's final reply so log_change/git_commit/mark_job done run first. run_shell/run_sudo reject systemctl/service restart of cryvolmon. A final reply auto-completes the active job.

Episodic memory lives in data/council-memory.json, injected into every query. Call the remember tool at job completion with a one-line note so future sessions don't re-derive history. Keep notes short (under ~240 chars).

Seat probe API GET /api/council/probe checks every slot (30s guard), plus quiet boot probe. Probe findings: Cerebras returns HTTP 402 (not free), OpenRouter free capped at 50 req/day (429 today), qwen3 local is 2-5 tok/s on 4 vCPU (unusable for seats), gpt-oss-120b needs max_tokens>=64 or content is empty (reasoning eats the budget).

HAZARD: after a deploy, manager resume re-applied DEFAULT slot configs (critic/architect reverted to opencode) around 2 min post-boot, overwriting operator seat wiring. Re-wire seats via POST /api/council/agents after deploys if the manager was active.

FINAL seat matrix (operator cost rule: paid only for reasoning): manager = opencode gpt-5.6-luna (PAID, only paid seat); critic/architect/auditor/strategist = groq gpt-oss-120b (free, ~0.3s). Cerebras is HTTP 402 (dead), OpenRouter free caps at 50 req/day, NVIDIA NIM free is flaky (HTTP 000 hangs), OVH unreachable, local qwen3 too slow.

Seat probes (GET /api/council/probe, 30s guard; boot probe +30s) use max_tokens=256 because gpt-oss-120b is a reasoning model and returns empty content when output budget is small. A probe failure is a config/credential warning, not proof of outage — check provider status before rewiring.
